records.name: Sergeant Schonmalweiter
records.biography_en: Turns every missing direction into a loudly announced shortcut. His whistle sorts HyperNorm corridors into forward and obstructive. A dissonant card keeps pointing toward a door omitted from his map. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Weg ist frei. Das Ziel wird nachgeliefert.

variant_notes.note_en: Turns every missing direction into a loudly announced shortcut.

records.name: Private Päckchen
records.biography_en: Carries everything required except a convincing explanation of where he is. He guards a canvas pouch containing spare instructions, all mutually exclusive. A dissonant card has volunteered to explain them. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Vollständig ausgerüstet für eine noch unbekannte Lage.

variant_notes.note_en: Carries everything required except a convincing explanation of where he is.

records.name: Corporal Knister
records.biography_en: Can hear a bad order clearly through any amount of static. She connects the HyperNorm radio to headquarters and hears two approved truths collide. Her handset stays off the hook for lost neighbours. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Empfang ist hervorragend. Der Inhalt stört.

variant_notes.note_en: Can hear a bad order clearly through any amount of static.

records.name: Lieutenant Himmelwärts
records.biography_en: Believes altitude will eventually improve the paperwork. He studies a chart that insists every HyperNorm ceiling is open sky. A dissonant card marks a safe landing nobody authorized. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Flughöhe genügt. Der Überblick fehlt.

variant_notes.note_en: Believes altitude will eventually improve the paperwork.

records.name: Medic Ruhigblut
records.biography_en: Insists that everyone panic one at a time. She bandages every HyperNorm resident before asking which side they belong to. Her classification system therefore receives complaints. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Beruhigung erfolgt gegebenenfalls im Befehlston.

variant_notes.note_en: Insists that everyone panic one at a time.

records.name: Mechanic Drehmoment
records.biography_en: Repairs vehicles faster than officers can rename the fault. His spanner loosens bolts but cannot loosen the HyperNorm maintenance policy. The oil can is reserved for squeaky doors and frightened visitors. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Technisch erledigt. Organisatorisch weiterhin defekt.

variant_notes.note_en: Repairs vehicles faster than officers can rename the fault.
